For PLA 3D printing, my top recommendation is a textured PEI spring steel build plate. It offers the best balance of adhesion, easy print removal, durability, and convenience.

Why textured PEI wins: PLA sticks reliably at approximately 50–60°C, and prints generally release easily once the plate cools. You typically don't need glue or other adhesives.

One important exception: If you print exclusively PLA, smooth PEI may actually be better, especially for small parts and detailed models. Prusa specifically recommends smooth or satin PEI for the strongest PLA adhesion.

My ideal choice would be a dual-sided smooth PEI + textured PEI plate, giving you both options.
